copy.tagline: 集成 Resend 邮件通道到聊天应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天应用中添加邮件发送功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Resend email channel into chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add email sending to a chat application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 Resend 收发邮件，把邮件线程变成对话。
howto.when: 当用户完成安装和配置，并通过 /manage-channels 将 Resend 通道绑定到智能体组后触发。

say.text: 帮我给 bot@yourdomain.com 发一封测试邮件。
say.note: Claude 会通过 Resend 发送邮件。

say.text: 检查我邮箱里有没有新邮件。
say.note: Claude 会读取 Resend 收到的邮件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive emails via Resend, turning email threads into conversations.
howto.when_en: Triggered after completing installation and configuration, and binding the Resend channel to an agent group via /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Send a test email to bot@yourdomain.com.
say_en.note: Claude will send an email via Resend.

say_en.text: Check my inbox for new emails.
say_en.note: Claude will read emails received via Resend.
